title: Well-formedness of a combined circuit
statement: Let $C$ and $C'$ be well-formed algebraic circuits on the same $n$ input variables: each circuit has at least one gate, and every gate referring to nodes refers only to earlier nodes. Form a circuit by listing the gates of $C$, then the gates of $C'$ with every node reference shifted by the size of $C$, and finally a subtraction gate whose inputs are the last nodes of the two circuits. The resulting circuit is well formed.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ and $C'$ are circuits on the same $n$ input variables
